sam: Heads-up : saw a spike in playbook churn for accounts undergoing CRM merges. Need a durable "quarantine"/safelist approach so playbooks don't double-touch records during syncs. Anyone free to brainstorm a quick MVP?
nina: I'd love that. Problem is we already have a short-term mute for templates but it's per-template and not account-scoped. We need account-first semantics.
rohan: Proposal: add a cs_quarantine table (account_id, source, actor, reason, created_at, ttl_seconds, audit_id). Runner checks for active quarantine and skips. Keep audit for 45 days.
sam: Good. Also add a reason enum so UI shows clear states (merge_in_progress, onboarding_handoff, data_cleanup).
cs-admin-bot: dry-run: scanning staging dataset : 1,742 accounts with recent owner churn; 412 flagged as likely true positives. Report: https://redwood.internal/reports/cs/quarantine/1743219999
nina: For DB safety, upsert by account_id + source. For overlapping quarantines choose the longest expires_at. Pseudocode: ```sql
INSERT INTO cs_quarantine (account_id, source, expires_at, ...) VALUES (...) 
ON CONFLICT (account_id, source) DO UPDATE SET expires_at = GREATEST(cs_quarantine.expires_at, EXCLUDED.expires_at), actor = EXCLUDED.actor, reason = EXCLUDED.reason;
```
rohan: Also add an admin console list filter: show quarantined accounts and allow CS agents to add temporary notes and manually lift a quarantine. Manual lifts must create an audit_event.
sam: Important: playbook-runner should emit a metric quarantine_skip{reason} and an event with run_id so we can trace missed nudges for follow-up.
nina: QA: tests for race conditions when two systems set quarantines at same time, and for manual override flow where agent sends a manual email while account is quarantined. Manual sends should be allowed only with override header and logged.
rohan: Plan: 1) migration for cs_quarantine table 2) runner guard + metric emission 3) admin console UI 4) audit sweeper job to delete >45d. Feature-flag cs_quarantine_v1 default OFF. Rollout 10% then ramp.
sam: I'll open tickets and loop in Enablement for a one-pager on what quarantine means so CS agents don't get surprised. Also add an alert if quarantines/day > 200 to catch accidental bulk application.
cs-admin-bot: task-created: CS-7710 quarantine MVP (assignee: rohan). Job queued: migration preview 1743219999-01.
rohan: I'll have a PR by EOD with migration and runner changes; Nina can own the UI ticket. ETA staged deploy tomorrow morning.
nina: Thanks — I'll mock the console badge and note the audit fields to display.
sam: Great work. Closing thread; post PR and ticket links here once created.
